conflicts: Main p.3 lists Scherrer sizes 13.4, 11.0, 10.2, 8.9 and 11.8 nm after discussing Figure2 e–i, whose caption orders ethanol through water. Table1 instead explicitly labels these values TW, TWE4, TWE1, TWE0.25 and TE. Numeric sample assignments here follow the explicit Table1 row labels; the conflicting prose order is retained, not silently resolved.
Main pp.3 and5 describe the mixed-solvent TEM range as47.0 to9.0nm, while Table1 explicitly reports9.7nm for TWE0.25. The labeled table value remains9.7nm; no replacement by9.0nm.
Table1 calls DTEM a diameter even for rodlike TW and rectangular TE. Their separate approximate length/width descriptions are preserved and are not substituted for the table metric.

Main p.3 assigns the TW HRTEM spacings3.4 and4.8Å to(101) and(002), respectively; Figure4a visibly labels0.34nm and an(001) growth arrow. These source labels are retained without crystallographic correction or invented atomic coordinates.
Main p.5 describes [001] growth as approximately2.7 times[101] but prints G100≈2.7G101. Both notations are retained as source interpretation, not a measured growth-rate result.
Table1 and p.4 print the calculated-area expression S=6/d*ρ. The literal expression and author-derived status are preserved; no density value, operator correction or recomputation is introduced.
